task.description: Write test specs and integration test code for QRY-01, QRY-02, QRY-03, and QRY-04. Every MUST acceptance criterion must have a corresponding integration test. Output: (1) tests/specs/QRY-01.md, tests/specs/QRY-02.md, tests/specs/QRY-03.md, tests/specs/QRY-04.md; (2) tests/integration/query_qry01_04_test.zig with integration tests hitting POST /api/v1/entities/{entity_key}/query. Tests must cover: SQL injection defence (filter value as param, not interpolated), operator rejection for unknown ops, field rejection for non-allowlisted fields, keyset cursor encode/decode, page_size cap enforcement, emptyEnvelope identical for deny and unknown entity_key (byte-for-byte comparison), EntityQueryExecuted audit event recorded, no filter values in audit log, tenant isolation (cross-tenant probe returns emptyEnvelope). Wire the new test file into build.zig and tests/integration/main_test.zig.

result.summary: Produced 4 test spec files (tests/specs/QRY-01..04.md) covering all MUST acceptance criteria. Produced tests/integration/query_qry01_04_test.zig with 14 distinct test blocks: qry01_valid_eq_filter_returns_matching_rows, qry01_unknown_op_returns_400_operator_not_recognised, qry01_filter_value_is_positional_param_not_interpolated, qry01_read_only_no_dml, qry01_audit_event_recorded_without_filter_values, qry02_non_allowlisted_field_returns_400, qry02_sort_non_allowlisted_field_returns_400, qry03_default_page_size_is_50, qry03_page_size_exceeds_max_returns_400, qry03_cursor_pagination_returns_next_page, qry03_cursor_sort_mismatch_returns_400, qry04_denied_entity_returns_empty_envelope, qry04_unknown_entity_returns_same_empty_envelope, qry04_cross_tenant_probe_returns_empty_envelope. All tests call handleEntityQuery directly against a real PostgreSQL DB. Wired into build.zig (test-integration-qry01-04 step + test_integration_others_step umbrella) and tests/integration/main_test.zig. Exposed entity_query_routes via src/bpm.zig. zig build check passes (check_fmt_scope: PASSED). Committed as 76d6702b on feature/WF02-qry01-04-20260818.
